subject: Admin-event ledger export: scope, delivery format, and timeline for Northriver SOC2 request
messages:
From: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@northriverhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Northriver Audit Team <audits@northriverhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 15:09:00 -0400
Subject: Request: admin-event ledger extract for SOC2 evidence (12 months)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this — Northriver is collecting audit evidence for an upcoming SOC2 review and we need a machine-readable export of the admin activity ledger covering the last 12 months (2024-09-12 to 2025-09-12).

Specifically we need:
- All admin/operator events (console + API) with timestamps and actor identifiers
- A manifest with per-file SHA256 checksums and row counts
- A delivery mechanism (we prefer an S3 transfer to our account or a secure pre-signed S3 share)
- Confirmation of retention policy and whether any events are redacted or PII-scrubbed in the export

Attached is a short checklist from our auditor that highlights required fields (timestamps in UTC, actor id, action, target resource id, outcome). Can you confirm the export format options and an ETA? Also include any chain-of-custody notes we should hand to the auditor.

Best,
Jamie
Jamie Porter
Lead Auditor — Northriver Health
attachments: NRH_Soc2_Evidence_Request.pdf
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@northriverhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 18:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin-event ledger extract for SOC2 evidence (12 months)

Jamie — thanks, we can do this. Quick summary of what is logged, retention, and delivery options so you can confirm scope before we schedule work: 

What we log (admin-event ledger):
- Authentication events: successful/failure sign-ins (including MFA), SSO assertions (timestamp, actor_id, source IP)
- Authorization changes: role/permission grants and revocations (who changed, prior/pending state)
- User lifecycle: create/disable/delete of user accounts and service principals
- Console/API operations: model deployment/rollback, resource create/delete (workspace, dataset, model), API key create/revoke, config changes
- Administrative system actions: scaling/instance lifecycle, autoscaling policy changes, billing admin actions
- Evaluation & runtime changes: model-version pinning, quantization/deploy config changes

Retention: default admin-event ledger retention is 18 months. For enterprise customers we can produce exports covering up to 7 years via archival pull (requires extra lead time and an export map).

Export formats & delivery options:
- NDJSON (line-delimited JSON) — recommended for event-level fidelity
- Parquet — recommended for analytics teams (columnar, smaller size)
- Compressed TAR.GZ bundle of files with a manifest.csv listing filename, sha256, row_count, start_ts, end_ts
- Delivery: cross-account S3 put via pre-arranged IAM role, presigned multi-part uploads, or secure SFTP in rare cases

Redaction: exports include raw actor identifiers (internal IDs). We can apply on-export redaction rules to mask email local-parts or remove IP geolocation fields if requested — note this is irreversible for the export and will be called out in the manifest.

Lead time & cost: snapshot exports take ~3 business days for <= 90 days of data. For 12 months expect 7-10 business days (we need to stage from the cold archive if any data has been tiered). There is a one-time export engineering fee for >6 month pulls unless already covered by your contract.

Chain-of-custody & manifest: we will produce a signed manifest.csv that includes file paths, sha256 checksums, row counts, exported_by, and an export_timestamp (UTC). If you need notarized/hash-signed handoff we can include a PGP-signed manifest or enterprise-level time-stamping.

Next step: confirm (A) timeframe (12 months OK), (B) preferred format (NDJSON + Parquet preferred), and (C) delivery method (cross-account S3 with role vs. pre-signed uploads). Once confirmed I will loop in engineering and provide a delivery date.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: admin-event ledger extract for SOC2 evidence (Northriver) — export plan

Monica/Markus — Jamie from Northriver confirmed they need 12 months of admin-event logs and prefer NDJSON + Parquet delivered into their S3. Can you confirm feasibility and ETA? Notes below: 

Requirements I distilled:
- Window: 2024-09-12T00:00:00Z — 2025-09-12T23:59:59Z
- Event schema (required fields): event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_id (internal id), actor_type (user/service), action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, source_ip (optional redaction), user_agent, outcome (success/fail), delta (kv diff)
- Output: split by month into ndjson files (admin-events-2024-09.ndjson ...) + equivalent Parquet, plus manifest.csv with sha256 per file
- Manifest columns: filename,s3_path,start_ts,end_ts,row_count,sha256,exported_by,exported_at
- Redaction: if they request, mask source_ip to prefix only (x.x.x.*) and mask email local parts; include a redaction_reason in manifest
- Transfer: cross-account S3 put; we need their target bucket ARN and a trust role for our service account

Engineering considerations:
- Large window will require reading from tiered storage. For 12 months estimate 5 business days runway (staging + verify). If we include Parquet conversion + PGP-signed manifest add 2 days.
- We must not include full user emails in plaintext in the export unless agreed. Confirm default masking policy.
- Provide export runbook and presigned test file ahead of full export for validation.

Monica — can you scope the staging job and give a firm ETA and estimated compressed size? Markus — can you review redaction steps and confirm the manifest signing options (PGP vs internal HSM stamp)?

Thanks —
Tessa
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@northriverhealth.com>, Northriver Audit Team <audits@northriverhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin-event ledger extract for SOC2 evidence (12 months) — delivery plan confirmed

Jamie — we confirmed scope with engineering. Summary and next steps below: 

Agreed scope:
- Window: 2024-09-12T00:00:00Z through 2025-09-12T23:59:59Z (12 months)
- Formats: NDJSON (monthly slices) + Parquet (optional analytics copy)
- Files: monthly NDJSON files + monthly Parquet files; all files bundled into compressed tar.gz for final handoff
- Manifest: admin_activity_manifest_20250925.csv (columns: filename,s3_path,start_ts,end_ts,row_count,sha256,exported_by,exported_at,redaction_applied)
- Redaction: we will mask email local-parts and truncate source IPs to /24 unless you request full field; redaction will be explicitly called out in the manifest
- Delivery method: cross-account S3 put into the bucket you provide via an assumed role. Please provide bucket ARN + role ARN by 2025-09-20. If you prefer presigned multi-part uploads, confirm and provide an HTTPS endpoint.

Schedule & cost:
- Export staging & verification complete by 2025-09-25 (target delivery date)
- Parquet conversion + PGP-signing of manifest completes by 2025-09-27
- One-time engineering export fee: quoted separately in a short invoice; we will send that after you confirm delivery method

Attachments we will include with the handoff:
- admin_activity_manifest_20250925.csv (sha256-summed, PGP-signed)
- export_instructions_s3.txt (how to validate files and manifest; includes sample s3 paths and verification commands)
- signed MOU (if requested)

Please confirm: preferred delivery (role-based S3 put vs. presigned), and provide the bucket ARN + role by EOD 2025-09-20 so we can hit the 9/25 target.

If you’d like, we can also enable a streaming audit feed to your account for ongoing collection (pubsub/S3) after the snapshot — Markus indicated that is low-effort to enable for future quarters.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: admin_activity_manifest_20250925.csv, export_instructions_s3.txt, mou_signed.pdf
